description.value: A trailhead staging campground deep within Strathcona Park — BC's oldest provincial park and a 250,000-hectare mountain wilderness — suited to hikers and backpackers pushing into the alpine; hard vehicle access and a short snow-free window make it a committed stop, not a casual one.
